execution_policy: Parse an optional OBFigma.md BaseCell section headed # BaseCell or ## BaseCell separately and complete its parent-owned shared-foundation updates for GeneralOBBaseCell, GeneralOBVC.nextButton, Assets.xcassets/GeneralOB/Contents.json namespace metadata, and Assets.xcassets/GeneralOB/icon_back.imageset before page dispatch. Parse the opening 是否并发完成执行 value: true dispatches a document-ordered batch of three isolated page subagents concurrently, with fewer only when fewer than three eligible pages remain; false or missing dispatches one page subagent serially. Each subagent owns one page and, after success, creates exactly one page-specific git commit in its isolated worktree. The parent owns status markers, collects each concurrent batch, and integrates or blocks its results in document order before starting another batch. After every page is integrated or explicitly blocked, run one workspace/project scheme xcodebuild build action and provide one consolidated summary.
agent_dispatch: Parent-owned OBFigma.md status markers and deterministic integration are required. The parent processes a BaseCell section headed # BaseCell or ## BaseCell directly because it changes shared GeneralOBBaseCell, GeneralOBVC.nextButton, and GeneralOB/icon_back foundations; BaseCell is not a page, receives no page status marker or page agent, and is completed before page dispatch. Page-agent concurrency is selected by the opening 是否并发完成执行 value: true uses three isolated page agents for the next three eligible pages, while false or missing uses one. Each page subagent owns one page, uses an isolated worktree, creates exactly one page-specific commit after verification, and must not edit shared parent-branch GeneralOB files or queue markers directly. The parent integrates concurrent results in OBFigma.md document order and finishes the current batch before opening the next one.
parallel_execution_policy: Normalize the opening global rule by stripping optional Markdown list syntax, whitespace, and full-width brackets, then parse 是否并发完成执行 as a case-insensitive boolean. Eligible pages have a missing marker, todo, failed, or in_progress status left by a previous interrupted run; done, unresolved blocked, and pages already assigned in the current run are excluded. Missing or false means serial execution. True means a three-page concurrent batch: mark the next three eligible pages in_progress, launch three isolated page subagents concurrently, or only the remaining count when fewer than three pages remain, collect the whole batch, and integrate or block results in document order. Retry a failed page at its document position before later batch results. Invalid or conflicting values stop dispatch. BaseCell remains parent-owned and consumes no page-agent slot.
base_cell_section_policy: Treat an OBFigma.md section whose normalized heading is BaseCell, including # BaseCell or ## BaseCell, as a shared-foundation specification, not an OB page. Require every link to show its cell state, back button, and bottom next button. Limit implementation to the existing GeneralOBBaseCell declaration, GeneralOBVC.nextButton, and the shared asset target consisting of Assets.xcassets/GeneralOB/Contents.json plus Assets.xcassets/GeneralOB/icon_back.imageset; change the parent Contents.json only when needed to enable provides-namespace. Put unselected cell UI in baseView, selected cell effects in selectedBaseView, export the 44x44 pt back control as 88x88 @2x and 132x132 @3x PNG files resolving as GeneralOB/icon_back, put shared bottom-button styling in GeneralOBVC.nextButton, and do not add page cases, page data, page VCs, selection persistence, page asset namespaces, routing, status markers, or page agents.
circle_progress_control: When Figma shows a circular progress view, use GeneralOBCircleProgress with lineWidth cx390(14), trackColor #0F172A0D, and gradientColors #9E95FC / #5E7BFB unless the page announcement overrides this configuration.
collection_section_policy: When a page declaration contains CollectionSection, implement it as a GeneralOBCollectionSectionVC subclass and follow the current project's OBSleepVC cell hooks: registerCell() calls super.registerCell() before registering the page-specific cell; cell(_ c: UICollectionView, path: IndexPath) uses that cell only when path.item > 0 and otherwise returns super.cell(c, path: path). Also override sectionDetail(sec: Int) -> GeneralOBPageItem to return the selected section's Figma-defined expanded information rather than the base placeholder.

OBFigma.md BaseCell is a parent-owned shared-foundation section, not a page block; every link must show the cell, back button, and bottom next button, and implementation is limited to GeneralOBBaseCell, GeneralOBVC.nextButton, Assets.xcassets/GeneralOB/Contents.json namespace metadata, and the 44x44 pt Assets.xcassets/GeneralOB/icon_back.imageset PNG assets before page agents run.

OBFigma.md opening 是否并发完成执行 controls only page-agent scheduling: true runs document-ordered batches of three isolated page agents, while false or missing preserves serial execution; every page still owns one agent, one worktree, one commit, and one parent-managed status marker.
